propositions: When acceptance criteria become stale or invalidated by the fix itself, the completion verifier blocks close and offers no legitimate sanctioned path forward
Closing via --force-close or --ref to an old commit leaves inaccurate ticket state in the system, as the ticket permanently asserts criteria that no longer hold
The correct resolution path is to edit the ticket so criteria are accurate, re-pass plan review, then close against corrected criteria
--ref <landing-commit> is a legitimate close path only for criteria invalidated by subsequent commits, not for criteria invalidated by the fix itself or auto-generated unverifiable criteria
The plan-review close gate's stale-regver check strands completed work by forcing full re-review of already-executed plans when criteria registry changes
Documentation and auditable criterion-disposition records are needed to guide users toward accurate ticket closure instead of force-close or misverified closes
